arxiv-1710-03675.title: An Introduction to Rocker: Docker Containers for R
arxiv-1710-03675.creator: by Carl Boettiger, Dirk Eddelbuettel
arxiv-1710-03675.description: Abstract We describe the Rocker project, which provides a widely-used suite of Docker images with customized R environments for particular tasks. We discuss how this suite is organized, and how these tools can increase portability, scaling, reproducibility, and convenience of R users and developers.

arxiv-2201-11960.title: Optimum ratio between two bases in Bennett-Brassard 1984 protocol with second order analysis
arxiv-2201-11960.creator: Masahito Hayashi
arxiv-2201-11960.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Masahito Hayashi. Bennet-Brassard 1984 (BB84) protocol, we optimize the ratio of the choice of two bases, the bit basis and the phase basis by using the second order expansion for the length of the generation keys under the coherent attack. This optimization addresses the trade-off between the loss of transmitted bits due to the disagreement of their bases and the estimation error of the error rate in the phase basis.

arxiv-2205-01886.title: P 3 Ranker: Mitigating the Gaps between Pre-training and Ranking Fine-tuning with Prompt-based Learning and Pre-finetuning Conference: Proceedings of the 45th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval; July 11–15, 2022; Madrid, Spain. Proceedings of the
arxiv-2205-01886.creator: Xiaomeng Hu, Shi Yu, Chenyan Xiong, Zhenghao Liu, Zhiyuan Liu, Ge Yu
arxiv-2205-01886.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Xiaomeng Hu, Shi Yu, Chenyan Xiong, Zhenghao Liu, Zhiyuan Liu, Ge Yu. Compared to other language tasks, applying pre-trained language models (PLMs) for search ranking often requires more nuances and training signals. In this paper, we identify and study the two mismatches between pre-training and ranking fine-tuning: the training schema gap regarding the differences in training objectives and model architectures, and the task knowledge gap considering the discrepancy between the knowledge needed in ranking and that learned during pre-training.

arxiv-2210-04065.title: Distinct polytropic behavior of plasma during ICME-HSS Interaction
arxiv-2210-04065.creator: Kalpesh Ghag, Anil Raghav, Zubair Shaikh, Georgios Nicolaou, Omkar Dhamane, Utsav Panchal
arxiv-2210-04065.description: Abstract Interplanetary Coronal Mass Ejections (ICMEs) and High Speed Streams (HSSs) are noteworthy drivers of disturbance of interplanetary space. Interaction between them can cause several phenomena, such as; generation of waves, enhanced geo-effectiveness, particle acceleration, etc. However, how does thermodynamic properties vary during the ICME-HSS interaction remain an open problem.

arxiv-2303-01179.title: SHAP-IQ: Unified Approximation of any-order Shapley Interactions
arxiv-2303-01179.creator: Fabian FumagalliBielefeld University, CITECD-33619, Bielefeld, Germany ffumagalli@techfak.uni-bielefeld.de, Maximilian MuschalikLMU Munich, MCML MunichD-80539, Munich, Germany maximilian.muschalik@ifi.lmu.de Patrick KolpaczkiPaderborn UniversityD-33098, Paderborn, Germany patrick.kolpaczki@upb.de Ey
arxiv-2303-01179.description: Abstract Predominately in explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) research, the Shapley value (SV) is applied to determine feature attributions for any black box model. Shapley interaction indices extend the SV to define any-order feature interactions. Defining a unique Shapley interaction index is an open research question and, so far, three definitions have been proposed, which differ by their choice of axioms.

arxiv-2304-05473.title: Global QoS Policy Optimization in SD-WAN
arxiv-2304-05473.creator: Pham Tran Anh Quang, Jérémie Leguay, Xu Gong, Xu Huiying, Huawei Technologies Ltd, Paris Research Center, France, Dongguan Research Center, China
arxiv-2304-05473.description: Abstract In modern SD-WAN networks, a global controller is able to steer traffic on different paths based on application requirements and global intents. However, existing solutions cannot dynamically tune the way bandwidth is shared between flows inside each overlay link, in particular when the available capacity is uncertain due to cross traffic.

arxiv-2408-03335.title: Explainable AI-based Intrusion Detection System for Industry 5.0: An Overview of the Literature, associated Challenges, the existing Solutions, and Potential Research Directions
arxiv-2408-03335.creator: Naseem Khan, Kashif Ahmad, Aref Al Tamimi, Mohammed M. Alani, Amine Bermak, Issa Khalil
arxiv-2408-03335.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Naseem Khan, Kashif Ahmad, Aref Al Tamimi, Mohammed M. Alani, Amine Bermak, Issa Khalil. Industry 5.0, which focuses on human and Artificial Intelligence (AI) collaboration for performing different tasks in manufacturing, involves a higher number of robots, Internet of Things (IoTs) devices and interconnections, Augmented/Virtual Reality (AR), and other smart devices. The huge involvement of these devices and interconnection in various critical areas, such as economy, health, education and defense systems, poses several types of potential security flaws.

arxiv-2511-07093.description: Abstract We give bounds for dimension 0 persistent homology and codimension 1 homology of Vietoris–Rips, alpha, and cubical complex filtrations from finite sets related by enrichment (adding new elements), sparsification (removing elements), and aligning to a grid (uniformly discretizing elements).

arxiv-2511-22557.title: Nucleation of magnetic skyrmions on curvilinear surfaces using local magnetic fields
arxiv-2511-22557.creator: Sabri Koraltan, Joe Sunny, Emily Darwin, Daniel Rothhardt, Reshma Peremadathil-Pradeep, Michał Krupiński, Takeaki Gokita, Jakub Jurczyk, Amalio Fernández-Pacheco, Markus Weigand, Sebastian Wintz, Dieter Suess, Hans Josef Hug, Manfred Albrecht
arxiv-2511-22557.description: Abstract Magnetic skyrmions stabilized by interfacial Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya interactions (DMI) are promising candidates for applications in memory, logic, and neuromorphic computing. Beyond planar films, theoretical studies predict that curvature can influence skyrmion stability by introducing effective chiral interactions. Here, we investigate skyrmion formation on self-assembled polystyrene particles coated with Pt/Co/Ta multilayers by magnetron sputtering.

pmc-12732538.creator: Agata Michalska, Daniel Wolder, Anna Błażuk-Fortak, Aleksandra Gładyś-Jakubczyk, Michał Błażuk, Justyna Pogorzelska, Anna Zmyślna, Waldemar Brola, Grzegorz Świercz, Yuri Chaves Martins

PPP was defined as pain of any cause (not only related to surgery) appearing after CS and persisting for at least the three following months.

pmc-12836827.title: “It’s really about something! I can save the patient a lot of suffering if I get him to do it”: between care and coercion in the use of non-invasive ventilation
pmc-12836827.creator: Anna-Henrikje Seidlein, Susanne Jöbges
pmc-12836827.description: BackgroundDespite clear evidence that non-invasive ventilation (NIV) is important and effective, both staff and patients report challenges. Patients often perceive NIV as unpleasant, and their acceptance is poor. For healthcare professionals, the patient’s insufficient adherence is demanding and requires considerable expertise, personnel and time resources.

pmc-13075434.title: Thirteen Foreign Bodies Retained in the Vagina for More Than 20 Years in a Postmenopausal Woman: Case Report
pmc-13075434.creator: Yanlin Jing, Fangdan Xu, Yujie Fu, Minwen Zhao, Haiyan Shan
pmc-13075434.description: Vaginal foreign bodies (VFBs) can affect women of all ages, but they are most frequently observed in the pediatric population. Such cases are relatively uncommon in women of reproductive age and postmenopausal women, and the long-term retention of foreign bodies in adults is particularly rare.

pmc-13434271.title: A vision-based framework for quantifying fish feeding behavior in industrial recirculating aquaculture systems
pmc-13434271.creator: Changrui Hu, Ziquan Feng, Yuanhang Li, Juan Chen, Shanzhou Wei, Xin Guo, Zemin Zhang
pmc-13434271.description: Accurate quantification of fish feeding intensity is critical for optimizing feeding strategies and reducing feed waste in industrial recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS). However, real-world aquaculture environments present significant challenges, including high-density fish populations, water surface disturbances, and dynamic behavioral variations. To address these issues, this study proposes a hybrid vision-based framework (HVIT) for robust feeding intensity analysis.

pmc-13617274.title: Risk factors and preventive strategies for precocious puberty: a narrative review
pmc-13617274.creator: Jia-Qi Lin, Tian-Tian Huang, Ji-Cheng Zhang, Xiang-Yun Tang, Yue Chen, Xiao-Fan Wu, Xin Zhang, En-Ze Lei
pmc-13617274.description: Precocious puberty (PP) is a common pediatric endocrine disorder with rising global incidence, significantly compromising children's quality of life and long-term health. Current therapeutic options remain limited in applicability, leaving many patients inadequately controlled. Prevention targeting known risk factors is substantially more cost-effective than post-diagnosis treatment; however, the available evidence on PP risk factors remains fragmented.

pmc-13625460.title: The effect of resistance band exercises on motor skills in female gymnasts
pmc-13625460.creator: Gül Halime Çelik, Sebiha Gölünük Başpınar
pmc-13625460.description: BackgroundIn gymnastics, where repetitive loading, sudden movements, and high-effort techniques are common, the use of adjustable elastic bands, tailored to individual differences, can safely support children’s motor development. Therefore, in our study, we examined the effects of elastic resistance band (ERB) exercises on motor children in gymnasts aged 8–12 years.

uslaw-usc-t18-s2325.title: 18 U.S.C. § 2325 — Definition
uslaw-usc-t18-s2325.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t18-s2325.description: United States Code, Title 18 (Crimes And Criminal Procedure); Part I (Crimes); Chapter 113A (Telemarketing And Email Marketing Fraud). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter, the term “telemarketing or email marketing”— (1) means a plan, program, promotion, or campaign that is conducted to induce— (A) purchases of goods or services; (B) participation in a contest or sweepstakes; (C) a charitable.
